items.markdown:
Smile lines, medically known as [nasolabial folds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasolabial_fold) , are the `creases that run from the sides of the nose to the corners of the mouth`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasolabial_fold)

### Causes

- **Aging:** Natural loss of collagen, elastin, bone density, and cheek volume causes skin to sag and fold.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/23027-nasolabial-folds)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WGoMQ7QsV4&t=65)
- **Facial Expressions:** Repeated muscle movements from smiling or laughing etch temporary lines into permanent creases over time.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WGoMQ7QsV4&t=65)
- **Lifestyle Factors:** Sun exposure (UV rays), smoking, and dehydration damage skin proteins and speed up aging.[[1]](https://www.phiclinic.com/condition/smile-lines)
- **Genetics:** Natural bone structure and skin thickness determine how early and deeply these folds appear.[[1]](https://www.phiclinic.com/condition/smile-lines)

### Treatments and Options

- **Topical Skincare:** Over-the-counter creams with retinol, vitamin C, and peptides can improve overall skin texture, though they cannot fix deep structural folds.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSBiFxlDL0q/?hl=en)
- **Dermal Fillers:** In-office hyaluronic acid or calcium hydroxyapatite fillers restore volume to the cheeks or directly soften the folds, with results lasting from 3 to 12 months.[[1]](https://www.nuffieldhealth.com/article/nose-to-mouth-lines-how-to-correct-smile-lines-both-surgically-and-non-surgically)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)
- **Surgical Options:** A facelift or mid-facelift provides a more permanent solution for severe sagging that fillers cannot correct.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[2]](https://www.nuffieldhealth.com/article/nose-to-mouth-lines-how-to-correct-smile-lines-both-surgically-and-non-surgically)
- **Skin Resurfacing:** Laser treatments or microneedling stimulate collagen production to smooth out fine lines.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)

### Prevention

- Wear daily sunscreen to protect against UV-induced collagen breakdown.
- Stay well-hydrated and maintain a balanced, plant-rich diet.
- Avoid smoking to preserve blood flow and skin elasticity.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)
